report:
In the medial compartment, there is horizontal tear at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, there is complex tear (main radial component) at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is focal osteochondral injury at mid weightbaring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.3* 1 cm).  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is acute complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligaments are intact There is anterior tibial translation. 
 There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament, at mid substance. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact The popliteofibular ligament is intact The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Minimal knee effusion is present in the left knee. The surrounding musculature is normal.    Focal osteochondral injury at mid weightbaring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.3* 1 cm), left knee.

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena prikazuju se uznapredovale OA promjene femorotibijalnog i
femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Denudacija tibijalne i kondilarne hrskavice medijalnog kompartmenta FT zgloba.
Patela je lateralno subluksirana (Wiberg 1) uz vidljivu gotovo potpuno reduciranu debljinu
artikulacijske hrskavice femoropatelarnog zgloba, osobito lateralne fasete patele i kondila
femura gdje je vidljiva hondromalacija IV. stupnja uz manji areal subhondralnog koštanog
edema. Vidljivi su rubni osteofiti femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Sitna osteohondralna lezija posteriornog dijela lateralnog kondila femura.
Više degenerativnih subhondralnih cističnih promjena zglobnih tijela FP zgloba te medijalnog
platoa tibije, najveća posteriorno dimenzija 8 x 12 mm.
Prednji križni ligament je mukoidno degeneriran.
Stražnji križni ligament je zadebljan s vidljivim intrasupstancijskim povišenjem intenziteta signala
fokalna mukoidna degeneracija.
Sitna ganglion cista neposredno uz hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta za tibiju promjera oko 5
mm.
Lezija I. stupnja MCL prvenstveno posljedično degenerativnim promjenama.
Prati se stanje po kompleksnoj ruptutri stražnjeg roga i trupa medijalnog meniska na
degenerativnoj podlozi uz ekstruziju meniska. Uz medijalni plato tibije vidi se okrugla lezija
promjera do 6 mm intenziteta meniska - flap rupturiranog meniska?
Distenzija posteriornog segmenta zglobne čahure medijalno.
Uz ventralni korijen lateralnog meniska vidi se slobodno zglobno tijelo niskih intenziteta signala
dimenzija 7 x 4 mm - kalcifikat?
Bakerova cista aksijalno dimenzija oko 21 x 20 mm. Umjereni izljev u zglobu.
Nešto tekućine uz hvatište tetive m. sartoriusa za femur (tenosinovitis).
Supkutani edem infrapatelarno i edem Hoffine masti.
Manja subhondralna cista glavice fibule promjera 6 mm.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Mild left knee joint effusion. Tiny uncomplicated popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Note some thinning and irregularity involving the cartilage of the weightbearing surface of the medial femoral condyle as is identified on the previous MRI. No subchondral bone marrow reactive changes.

The medial meniscus and medial collateral ligament are unremarkable.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Redemonstration of tearing of the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus with associated extrusion of the attenuated body of the meniscus. Appearances are again compatible with an unstable meniscal tear.

There is some marked thinning and irregularity of the articular cartilage involving the weightbearing surfaces of the lateral femoral and tibial condyles with associated mild focal subchondral bone marrow reactive signal intensity changes and some marginal osteophyte.

The fibular collateral ligament complex appears intact.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Redemonstration of marked the fissuring involving both the medial and lateral patellar facet, not significantly changed since the previous MRI, with some very minimal subchondral bone marrow reactive signal intensity change.

Morphology of the trochlear articular cartilage is unremarkable.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
Suspected multiple small osteochondral bodies projected within the posterior joint space medial to the posterior cruciate ligament.

CONCLUSION:
1.Redemonstration of an unstable tear involving the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus, as described.
2.Tricompartmental articular cartilage thinning and fissuring most prominently affecting the patellofemoral and lateral femorotibial compartments.
3.Some associated small multiple osteochondral bodies within the posterior joint space surrounded by synovial fluid.
4.Mild left knee joint effusion.

Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colateral lateral sin alteraciones. Discreto engrosamiento de predominio
baja señal del tercio proximal del ligamento colateral medial en su componente superficial. Resto
de los componentes sin alteraciones significativas.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Finas
úlceras condrales de espesor total de la faceta medial de la rótula con cambios óseos
secundarios.
No hay significativo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital asociado a discreto edema
del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano. Aumento de señal del tercio proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial sin alteraciones. Discreto edema
las partes blandas entre cóndilo femoral lateral y la banda iliotibial.
Discreto edema las partes blandas, profundo los tendones de la pata de ganso.
Impresión:
Leve engrosamiento, probablemente secuelar del tercio proximal del componente superficial del
ligamento colateral medial.
Condropatía focal grado 4 de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal asociado a edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital
suprarrotuliano.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Discretos fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial. Probables bursitis profunda a los tendones
de la pata de ganso

MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Trace joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low grade cartilage fissuring along the medial patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

Edema surrounding the distal iliotibial band at the level of the lateral femoral condyle.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Slight lateral patellar tilt, without translation. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings indicative of iliotibial band friction syndrome.
2.	No acute osseous or meniscal injury.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Artrosis.

Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que impresiona
contactar la superficie articular sugieran una rotura, no desplazada. Moderada extrusión meniscal
difusa.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de distribución difusa del compartimento femorotibial
medial con mínimos cambios óseos secundarios del cóndilo femoral medial y proliferaciones
óseas periféricas.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la región central y posterior del compartimento
femorotibial lateral sin cambios óseos secundarios.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de distribución difusa de la articulación patelofemoral
con proliferaciones óseas periféricas y discretos cambios óseos secundarios.

Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales. Tendón rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso,

Impresión:
Rotura del menisco medial con moderada extrusión meniscal.
Avanzados cambios degenerativos de los compartimentos femorotibial medial y patelofemoral.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Leve derrame articular con discreta sinovitis difusa.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağ tam kat-tam kata yakın yırtık. Arka çapraz bağ ve yan bağlar korunmuş. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzundaki dejenerasyona yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Lateral menisküs gövdesindeki vertikal oblik yırtık üst eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkileniyor. Patellofemoral eklem dejenerasyonu hafif derecede ve troklear oluğun medyalindeki ve lateral patellar fsetteki yüzeyel kondral düzensizlikler ile karekterize. Medyal ve lateral femoral tibyal eklem dejenerasyonu femoral kondillerin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki yüzeyel kondral düzensizlikler fokal tam kat kıkırdak kaybı ile birlikte. Semimembranozus tendonu insersiyon düzeyinde tendon içerisinde ve çevresinde 2,4 cm maksimum boyutlu gangliyon kistleri mevcut. Troklea displastik (Dejour tip A) ve patella laterale 5 mm translasyon gösteriyor. Patellanın yüksekliği normal. Ekstensör mekanizma bunların dışında korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.
